uncovered_shapes.sentence: Researchers noted the approach could reduce painful procedures and surgery for thousands of children while supporting wider regulatory review.
Earlier studies found no overall protective effect across broader populations.

claims.claim: A major clinical trial found a liquid applied to teeth in seconds stopped cavities in young children without drilling, injections, or anesthesia.
claims.episode_span: A major clinical trial tested a simple liquid applied to teeth in seconds and found it stopped cavities in young children.
claims.source_title: A simple liquid can stop cavities without drilling, major study confirms
claims.supporting_quote: A simple liquid painted onto teeth in seconds can stop cavities without drilling, injections, or anesthesia, according to a major clinical trial involving young children.

claims.claim: University of Tübingen researchers found two carrion crows averaged 235 milliseconds to identify dot-pattern direction and respond while maintaining high accuracy.
claims.episode_span: The birds averaged 235 milliseconds to identify direction and respond while maintaining high accuracy.
claims.source_title: Crows make decisions twice as fast as humans and monkeys
claims.supporting_quote: University of Tübingen researchers have shown that crows, when confronted with a visual choice, make a decision twice as fast as humans and monkeys. In the experiment, two carrion crows took just 235 milliseconds on average to identify the direction in which a dot pattern was moving and to indicate their choice—while maintaining a high degree of accuracy.

claims.claim: A large study linked consumption of two alcoholic beverages per day to a 1-in-25 lifetime risk of death from alcohol-related causes.
claims.episode_span: A large study linked consumption of two alcoholic beverages per day to a 1-in-25 lifetime risk of death from alcohol-related causes.
claims.source_title: Just two drinks a day may be far riskier than you think
claims.supporting_quote: A major new study reveals that drinking just two alcoholic beverages a day is associated with a 1 in 25 lifetime risk of death from alcohol-related causes, challenging the idea that moderate drinking is harmless.
